description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.



The Role

Product Engineers at Hadrian are software engineers who own the full product lifecycle, from figuring out what to build to shipping and operating it. You'll work directly with the people running mission-critical manufacturing programs, identify problems worth solving, and turn ambiguous requirements into working software.

Much of the work is 0 to 1. You'll build new products, extend existing systems, and help turn successful prototypes into durable platform capabilities. You'll spend most of your time writing code, primarily in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Go, and Python, but we care more about engineering judgment than familiarity with our stack.

There's no PM handing you a PRD and no layer between you and your users. Product judgment, technical depth, and the ability to move quickly all matter. The team is early, and the people joining now will have significant influence over both our product direction and how the team operates.

No prior aerospace, defense, or manufacturing experience required.



What You'll Do

 - Build and ship full stack products. Take software from an empty repo to production, with real users who depend on it.

 - Own a product area end to end. Stay on it from the first unclear conversation through design, build, launch, and iteration.

 - Make and document the technical calls. Choose the architecture, data models, and tradeoffs, and write them down for other engineers.

 - Do your own discovery. Talk to users, watch how they work, and find the real problem behind the request.

 - Ship fast, keep quality high, and feed the platform. Get working software to users early, keep code readable and tested, and bring requirements back to the core platform.



What We're Looking For

 - Deep software engineering experience. You’ve shipped full stack applications, worked in large codebases, and tech led critical projects.

 - Strong system design skills. You design services, APIs, and data models that hold up as usage grows.

 - Extreme product intuition and a 0-to-1 track record. You think as hard about what to build as how to build it, and you’re comfortable shipping in unclear environments.

 - Direct work with users, and clear communication. You turn customer needs into shipped software, explain tradeoffs to any audience, and push back when the ask doesn’t match the problem.

 - AI native, with a bias to action. You use AI across your whole workflow, can show how it makes you much faster, and care more about the right solution than being right.



What Will Set You Apart

 - Founder or founding engineer experience. You’ve taken a new product from 0 to 1.

 - Product ownership without a PM. You’ve owned a product area, or worked as an engineer and PM hybrid.

 - Operations tooling. You’ve built workflow tools or data heavy applications for operations teams.

 - Forward deployed experience. You’ve done forward deployed, solutions engineering, or technical consulting work built against messy customer reality.

 - A visible body of work. A strong GitHub presence or projects shipped outside of work.



Logistics 
This role is based out of our Los Angeles (Torrance) or San Francisco Bay Area office. You'll travel now and then to spend time onsite with customers and operators so you understand their work firsthand. This role does not involve heavy travel or long deployments.



Every Engineering, Product, and Design hire at Hadrian joins as a Member of Technical Staff (MTS). An MTS takes a problem from ambiguity to production, pushing hard at the edge of what AI agents can do to tame manufacturing problems that were intractable a year ago. Your unit of work is a problem solved, not a ticket or a pull request. You set the intent, build the verification loop, and then unleash agents on work that used to need a team. You own what your agents produce, end to end. You can explain what they do, why it is correct, and how the next set of agents will fix the problems this one surfaced.



Compensation

For this role, the target salary range is $223,000 - $359,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.


BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.
